pending.title: Why Ukraine’s defense industry may have hit a ceiling
pending.description: Ukraine’s defense industry fell apart after the Soviet Union collapsed, and by the start of Russia’s full-scale invasion, the country made almost no weapons of its own. After the invasion, however, the sector grew rapidly, largely thanks to European funding. That growth has let Ukraine keep fighting even as U.S. support has shrunk and the European Union has been unable to supply enough weapons.
